name: Grade 6 T3: Spreadsheets, Data, and Formulas
description: Spreadsheet vocabulary for data, information, rows, columns, cells, formulas, references, sums, and averages.

words.definition: A digital table used to organize, calculate, and study data.
words.example: The class used a spreadsheet to organize reading minutes.

words.definition: Facts, numbers, words, or observations that can be collected and used.
words.example: Favorite activities were collected as data.

words.definition: Data that has been organized or explained so it is useful.
words.example: The spreadsheet turned class answers into useful information.

words.definition: A horizontal line of cells in a spreadsheet.
words.example: Each row represented one student's answer.

words.definition: A vertical line of cells in a spreadsheet.
words.example: The column showed the number of minutes read.

words.definition: One box in a spreadsheet where data can be entered.
words.example: The student typed a number into one cell.

words.definition: A label at the top of a column or section.
words.example: The header told readers what each column meant.

words.definition: An organized set of information arranged in rows and columns.
words.example: The table had five rows of class data.

words.definition: A group of related data collected for a purpose.
words.example: The dataset showed each student's project role.

words.definition: To change how text, numbers, or cells look.
words.example: Students formatted the title and headers.

words.definition: The main name of a table, chart, or project.
words.example: The title explained what the data table was about.

words.definition: An instruction in a spreadsheet that calculates an answer.
words.example: The formula added the numbers in a column.

words.definition: The name of a cell, such as A1, used in a formula.
words.example: The formula used the cell reference B2.

words.definition: A spreadsheet function that adds numbers together.
words.example: SUM calculated the total minutes.

words.definition: A spreadsheet function that finds the usual or middle amount by adding values and dividing by how many there are.
words.example: AVERAGE found the class average reading minutes.

words.definition: To find an answer using math.
words.example: The spreadsheet calculated the total automatically.

words.definition: The final amount after adding values together.
words.example: The total showed all project materials added together.

words.definition: Data entered into a spreadsheet or program.
words.example: Changing the input changed the formula answer.

words.definition: The result produced by a formula, program, or process.
words.example: The output was the total shown by the formula.

words.definition: A number, word, or piece of data inside a cell.
words.example: The value in cell B3 was 12.

words.definition: A prepared file or layout that helps people start a task.
words.example: The teacher gave a formula practice template.

words.definition: To think about what happened and explain what was learned.
words.example: Students reflected on what changed when the input changed.
